bundle.shortDescription: Local models, flows, plugins, and hardware for FormLogic apps
bundle.longDescription: FormLogic Desktop is a tray-resident desktop app that manages local models, flows, plugins, and hardware for FormLogic apps — running local AI services (Ollama, ComfyUI, custom Python) and exposing them to FormLogic and the flow editor via a localhost API.
